label: REST
sign_hint: Hand relaxed / no sign. Never spoken. Record plenty of this class.

label: HELLO
sign_hint: Open flat hand at the forehead moving outward (salute).

label: THANK_YOU
sign_hint: Flat hand from chin moving forward and down.

label: YES
sign_hint: Fist (S hand) nodding up and down at the wrist.

label: NO
sign_hint: Index and middle finger tap down onto the thumb.

label: PLEASE
sign_hint: Flat hand on chest moving in a circle.

label: SORRY
sign_hint: Fist (A hand) on chest moving in a circle.

label: HELP
sign_hint: Fist (thumb up) resting on the flat other palm and lifted.

label: WATER
sign_hint: W hand (three fingers up) tapping the chin.

label: FOOD
sign_hint: Flat O hand (fingertips together) tapping the lips.

label: TOILET
sign_hint: T hand (thumb between index and middle) shaken side to side.

label: STOP
sign_hint: Flat hand chopping down vertically.

label: GOOD
sign_hint: Flat hand from chin moving down.

label: BAD
sign_hint: Flat hand from chin turned over and down.

label: NAME
sign_hint: H hands (index + middle) tapping twice.

label: I_LOVE_YOU
sign_hint: Thumb + index + little finger extended (ILY hand).

label: WHAT
sign_hint: Both hands open palms up shaking slightly.

label: WHERE
sign_hint: Index finger up waving side to side.

label: DOCTOR
sign_hint: M hand (three fingers) tapping the inside of the other wrist.

label: OK
sign_hint: Thumb and index tip touching (OK ring) other fingers up.

label: WAIT
sign_hint: Open hand palm up wiggling fingers.
